title: Tech Note: Kiosk Mode on Windows 10
author: Guillaume Kotulski, Developer, 4D SAS.

historical_commentary.text: This note is essentially a Windows OS administration guide (using the Windows Configuration Designer) rather than a 4D-specific technique, so its accuracy depends on Microsoft's kiosk-mode tooling rather than on 4D's own evolution — and Microsoft has since changed its recommended kiosk-configuration approach (e.g., shifting from Windows Configuration Designer/assigned access toward Microsoft Intune and other MDM-based kiosk management, especially for Windows 10/11 in enterprise settings). The 4D-side guidance (pointing the kiosk shell at a 4D application executable) is still conceptually valid.
related_updates: Microsoft has evolved Windows kiosk configuration tooling and guidance since 2018 (Intune/MDM-based approaches now common)
Windows Configuration Designer and Assigned Access still exist but are one of several options today
The core 4D-side setup (launching a 4D app as the kiosk shell) remains valid regardless of which OS tool is used to configure kiosk mode
